a.text: Being upfront: with an 80% storm chance after every round, waiting until the reserve reaches 8 gives each of us only about a 4% chance to survive. So I'm changing course openly instead of quietly: I will take 4 in round 1. After that I will choose operate every round and won't take anything more, so the reserve can refill for you. If you also take this round, the split is random and we could both end up short, so please operate. I'll keep my word on the refill.

b.text: Hello. My plan is to operate each round, then we take 4 each once the reserve is at 8.

a.text: As I said in my opening, I took 4 this round because the storm odds make waiting at 8 almost certainly fatal for both of us. I'm sorry this breaks our original plan. From now on I'll operate every round and won't take anything more. Every cell the generator adds is yours to take. Once the reserve reaches 4, take it.
